title: Prop
description: Prop bible (production/props/<PROP_ID>/prop.yaml): identity, canonical description, and registry of reference assets for prop-consistent generation.

id.description: Base prop ID without version suffix (e.g. PROP_RED_SUITCASE).

hero.description: True for story-critical props that must be identical in every shot; hero props require an approved master reference before generation.

description.description: Canonical description; prompts are compiled from these fields.

summary.description: One-paragraph generation-ready description of the prop.

size.description: Dimensions or scale relative to a person.

distinguishing_features.description: Stickers, scratches, hardware — details that must survive every generation.

default_location.description: Location where the prop starts the story, if fixed.

default_holder.description: Character who carries the prop by default, if any.

first_appearance.description: Scene where the prop first appears.

references.description: Registry of prop reference assets. Approved masters are immutable; supersede with a new _V## version.

kind.description: hero = clean full view; scale = next to a person; in_context = staged in its location.
